title_zh: 合伙人 · 美国注册会计师
bio_zh:
Susan Woo 是美国注册会计师，在中美两地拥有超过 25 年的审计及会计执业经验，服务行业涵盖科技、消费品、商业服务、自然资源与制造业。

她曾协助多家中国企业通过 IPO 或并购在美国上市，参与过买方与卖方并购、财务重组等多类投资银行交易，并为客户提供国际税务咨询。她深入理解中美财务制度的差异，帮助客户跨越两国在财务与税务政策上的鸿沟，同时也为美国企业投资中国大陆市场提供咨询。
show:
Susan Woo is a U.S. Certified Public Accountant with more than 25 years of audit and accounting experience in China and the U.S., across technology, consumer products, business services, natural resources and manufacturing.

She has helped a number of Chinese companies list in the U.S. through IPOs and mergers, and has worked on buy-side and sell-side M&A, financial restructurings and IPOs, as well as international tax. She understands the differences between the Chinese and U.S. financial systems in depth and helps clients bridge them. She also advises U.S. companies investing in mainland China.

bio_zh:
Miranda Sun 是美国注册会计师，在中美两地上市公司及私营企业会计方面拥有超过 20 年的经验。她深度参与客户在美上市的全过程，与客户的会计部门和审计师紧密合作，确保上市与财务报告按时、准确完成。

她在各行业 IPO、注册声明、反向并购与 SPAC 的复杂会计及 SEC 合规问题上经验丰富，尤其熟悉中国内地与香港企业的跨境业务。Miranda 精通英语、普通话和粤语。
show:
Miranda Sun is a U.S. Certified Public Accountant with more than 20 years of accounting experience at public and private companies in the U.S. and China. She works closely with clients’ accounting teams and auditors through the U.S. listing process so that listing and financial reporting are completed properly and on time.

She has extensive experience with complex accounting and SEC compliance for IPOs, registration statements, reverse mergers and SPACs, especially for businesses in mainland China and Hong Kong. Miranda is fluent in English, Mandarin and Cantonese.

title_zh: 联合创始人 · 美国注册会计师
bio_zh:
Raymond Choy 是卓越世纪的联合创始人之一，美国注册会计师及全球特许管理会计师，拥有超过 20 年的会计师事务所执业经验，专注于 SEC 上市公司审计与报告。

他擅长 SEC 申报、萨班斯法案（SOX 404）合规与财务尽职调查，曾协助客户在纽约证券交易所和纳斯达克上市，并在客户财务高管职位空缺时担任临时首席财务官或财务总监。Raymond 精通英语、普通话和粤语。
show:
Raymond Choy is a co-founder of Beyond Century Consulting and has more than 20 years of public accounting experience, with a focus on SEC public company audit and reporting. He is a U.S. Certified Public Accountant and a Chartered Global Management Accountant.

Raymond specializes in SEC reporting, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) 404 compliance and financial due diligence, and has helped clients list on the NYSE and Nasdaq. He has also served clients as interim CFO or controller when those roles were vacant. Raymond is fluent in English, Mandarin and Cantonese.

bio_zh: Jia Xia 是加州注册会计师，拥有超过 19 年的财务报告经验，专注于 SEC 申报、技术会计（US GAAP 与 IFRS）及并购交易。
show: Jia Xia is a California-licensed CPA with more than 19 years of financial reporting experience, focused on SEC reporting, technical accounting (U.S. GAAP and IFRS) and M&A transactions.
